svg.title: How Kai works
svg.desc: Three commands take a ticket to done. From level 2, /kai:spec explores the code, writes the spec, grills you on it, drafts any ADR for you to decide, writes the plan, and has a friendly, a skeptical and a neutral reviewer check all of it before the Definition PR, or says to skip it for a low-tier change. /kai:implement builds from the merged plan (planning and asking for approval only when none was merged), commits failing tests, writes the minimum code, proves it, reviews it, and answers the change PR reviewers until a person merges it. At level 4, /kai:accept verifies the deployed change and tries to break it. When it passes, it runs the retro and opens a cleanup PR. When it fails, it fixes the failure itself on a fix branch, opens the fix PR, and verifies again once it merges and deploys.
